scope: SUP racing; labels and practice suggestions are product synthesis, not diagnostic criteria or a prescribed training plan.

issues.label: Air catch
issues.evidence_required: Side-view video showing entry relative to the board.
issues.practice: Practice slow entries, then a few normal strokes.

issues.label: Loading before the blade is buried
issues.observation: Pull begins with incomplete blade immersion or visible aeration.
issues.evidence_required: Side-view video and, where available, sound at entry.
issues.practice: Alternate quiet placement strokes and normal paddling.

issues.label: Overreaching that disrupts connection
issues.observation: Extra reach is followed by loss of balance or delayed engagement.
issues.evidence_required: Side/front video over several strokes; athlete report.
issues.practice: Compare comfortable reach with the usual setup at easy effort.

issues.label: Early arm-dominant pull
issues.observation: Elbow bends early while the body contributes little to moving past the blade.
issues.evidence_required: Side video and coach review of load sequence.
issues.cue: Let the body contribute to the loaded stroke.
issues.practice: Rehearse connected body movement at low effort.

issues.label: Top hand drives forward too early
issues.observation: Forward top-hand motion quickly removes the initial positive blade angle.
issues.evidence_required: Side video; watch data cannot measure blade angle.
issues.practice: Observe top-hand path during a few controlled strokes.

issues.label: Rotation finishes before useful loading
issues.observation: Hip/shoulder movement finishes early and leaves little coordinated drive.
issues.evidence_required: Side/front video with a coach or experienced observer.
issues.practice: Compare a controlled sequence with the habitual stroke.

issues.label: Dragging or lifting water at exit
issues.observation: Release includes obvious unproductive drag or lifting water.
issues.evidence_required: Side video including blade and board response.
issues.practice: Compare release timing at similar effort.

issues.label: Tense recovery
issues.observation: Grip/shoulders remain visibly tense and preparation becomes hurried.
issues.evidence_required: Athlete report plus front/side video where available.
issues.cue: Soften the recovery while retaining control.
issues.practice: Use easy strokes to observe recovery tension.

issues.label: Unintended sweeping on forward strokes
issues.observation: A repeated outward blade path accompanies unwanted yaw.
issues.evidence_required: Front/rear video; GPS can only suggest broad course variation.
issues.cue: Align the stroke with the intended course.
issues.practice: Practice a straight corridor and observe paddle path.

issues.label: Balance corrections interrupt propulsion
issues.observation: Repeated unplanned braces or foot adjustments interrupt forward strokes.
issues.evidence_required: Video or athlete report; timed events may corroborate.
issues.cue: Keep the stance adaptable to the water.
issues.practice: Practice controlled easy paddling in manageable conditions.

issues.label: Delayed connection after a side change
issues.observation: A side change repeatedly creates an extended gap before the next catch.
issues.practice: Rehearse hand exchanges slowly, then in normal strokes.

issues.label: Lost momentum through a buoy turn
issues.observation: Approach, footwork or delayed exit acceleration breaks the intended turn rhythm.
issues.evidence_required: Video and a known buoy/turn interval.
issues.cue: Link the approach, turn and exit.
issues.practice: Repeat a controlled turn and compare exit rhythm.

issues.label: Unsustainable rate–load combination
issues.observation: A chosen rhythm repeatedly loses quality before the intended effort ends.
issues.evidence_required: Athlete report and repeated comparable intervals; video for biomechanical attribution.
issues.practice: Compare short, matched efforts without chasing cadence alone.

issues.label: Side-dependent loss of connection
issues.observation: One side repeatedly shows weaker connection or more disruption under comparable conditions.
issues.evidence_required: Side-labelled video/observations; watch cadence alone cannot label the paddling side.
issues.cue: Observe each side before prescribing a change.
issues.practice: Compare side-labelled efforts with course and conditions recorded.
